summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Stripe Checkout integration for AuditEngine (Flow A · SMP). 21/21 tests passed. Verified: happy-path checkout for both plans returning valid https://checkout.stripe.com URLs, pydantic validation (invalid lookup_key, missing origin_url, empty body, out-of-range quantity all return 422), Mongo payment_transactions row persisted before response with correct amount (4900 monthly, 49000 yearly, currency=eur, status=initiated, payment_status=pending), idempotency (two calls produce two distinct session_ids and DB rows), /api/payments/status/{sid} returns exactly {session_id,status,payment_status} with no PII, unknown session_id returns 404, Stripe Price catalog amounts match (4900/49000 EUR recurring month/year), success_url/cancel_url shape verified via stripe.Session.retrieve, webhook rejects missing and invalid Stripe-Signature with 400, unique index on session_id and descending index on created_at present, regression on /api/public/registry, /api/public/verify, /api/regulator/sandbox, /api/audits still passing. Also confirmed the previously-flagged /api/auth/session empty-body 500 has been FIXED (now returns 400).
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_billing.py line 18: fallback `stripe.api_key = ... or 'sk_test_emergent'` masks a missing secret at import time; would produce confusing 401s from Stripe rather than a clear startup failure. Consider raising if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY missing.

stripe_billing.py line 36: when Price.list returns empty (misconfigured catalog) endpoint raises HTTPException(500). Since lookup_key is already whitelisted by pydantic regex, a 500 is acceptable but arguably should be 503 (config error) rather than 500.

stripe_billing.py get_status: reads live session from Stripe on every non-paid poll. For high-traffic pricing pages this could hit Stripe rate limits; consider caching or relying on webhook exclusively.
server.py at ~876 lines still exceeds >700 recommended threshold — Stripe route mount is clean but overall file should be split (auth, public registry, audits, stripe) into modular routers.

No cleanup / TTL on payment_transactions rows in `initiated`/`pending` state — will accumulate abandoned-cart rows indefinitely. Consider TTL index on created_at with `partialFilterExpression` for payment_status=='pending'.

handle_stripe_webhook: charge.refunded handler updates by stripe_payment_intent_id but this field is only populated post-completion; refund on a Session that never wrote the intent (edge case) would silently no-op.
test_credentials: None required for Stripe endpoints. Backend .env provides STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (sandbox test mode).
seed_data_creation: Test created ~7 payment_transactions rows (all in `initiated/pending` state, sandbox sessions). Not cleaned up — mirror real user-abandoned checkouts. Recommend TTL index (see code-review comment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe integration is production-quality on the backend side. Prices confirmed at 4900 EUR/mo and 49000 EUR/yr under lookup_keys professional_monthly & annual_yearly. Webhook signature validation works. DB row is written before response (row-before-return semantics preserved). The previously-flagged /api/auth/session empty-body 500 has been fixed to 400. Frontend /pricing and /payment/{success,cancel} were skipped per request.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Stripe integration.
